fault_units.purpose: Reintroduce the strong Inventory-to-authority edge WeakRef was adopted to remove, while a tiny StrongEquipmentReference.get_ref() keeps returning null for an actually freed Node via is_instance_valid(), so the never-bound and explicit-unbind gate logic is untouched and only the retention behavior changes. Proves the real Gear/Inventory/Residents mutual-release witness, and every stub-authority 'expiry' witness, actually depend on the WeakRef repair rather than passing for an unrelated reason.

class StrongEquipmentReference extends RefCounted:
	"""SEMANTIC-FAULT UNIT1: restores the strong ownership edge WeakRef was meant to remove.
	`get_ref()` mirrors WeakRef's live/freed-Node-safe contract via `is_instance_valid`, so
	callers observe identical behavior right up until the retention cycle itself.
	"""
	var target: Object = null

	func _init(p_target: Object) -> void:
		target = p_target

	func get_ref() -> Object:
		return target if is_instance_valid(target) else null

var _equipment_authority: StrongEquipmentReference = null
